beta.release_notes:
Promoted to Stable by CP on 2026-09-28. Exact accepted beta.1 installer bytes; physical release identity remains 9.4.6-beta.1. No rebuild.

Field validation remains pending for GTX1650/Paddle/Qwen accuracy, speed and blocked-read cancellation; official Trimble .job conversion; and rod confidence calibration. Production signing is not activated.

# SurveySync 9.4.6-beta.1 — review workflow repair

A partial crew recheck remains open until every requested record is returned. Previously recorded partial returns from 9.4.5 are detected and may be completed without losing the earlier observation.

The Revision & Delivery Review workspace now offers a download button for each saved PDF/CSV review ZIP. Downloads are bound to the active project and verified against the saved SHA-256. Native desktop sessions can reveal the report folder after generation.

Unresolved duplicate PointID pairings from the latest revision now block readiness. A new revision, recheck or returned observation, point range reservation, evidence attachment, or policy change invalidates earlier report readiness and reviewer acknowledgment. Create a current report and acknowledge the new review state before delivery.

This candidate preserves source observations and canonical coordinates. Windows installer acceptance remains required before publication.
